parties.respondent: M/S Oriental Insurance Company Ltd Rep. by Its Divisional Manager & Ors.

summary: Motor accident compensation appeal; High Court reduction of award challenged; Tribunal award based on partnership income, multiplier, and future prospects; High Court erred in ignoring active partnership role, downfall in business post-death, and dependents' inexperience; reliance on B Parimala and K Ramya clarified; reduction beyond scope of insurer's appeal; compensation restoration sought.
legal_provisions_cited: B Parimala v Riyaz Ahmed, 2000 SCC OnLine Kar 446
K Ramya v National Insurance Co. Ltd., 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1338
Sushma H.R. & Anr. v Deepak Kumar Jha & Ors., 2022 SCC OnLine SC 2166
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Tribunal award reinstated with interest @ 7.5% p.a.
